subject: Recap + pilot charter: NovaPay inference cost pressure & quantization openness
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novapay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + pilot charter: NovaPay inference cost pressure & quantization openness

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap so we have alignment and clear next steps.

Summary of pain / goals you shared:
- Monthly token spend peaking at ~35M tokens (customer-facing NLU + embeddings).
- Unit economics squeezed: current per-token spend + infra is driving 30–40% margin pressure on your chat/assist product.
- Latency target: p95 < 250ms for interactive flows; throughput for bulk embedding jobs during nightly windows.

Current stack you described:
- Model host: in-house cluster on GCP running mixed GPU VMs for generation; some third-party hosted API usage for experimental models.
- Serving: single-threaded endpoints today, limited batching in product infra.
- Observability: basic request logs; no token-level cost attribution per route yet.

Success criteria (what success looks like to NovaPay):
- 30–40% reduction in per-token inference cost (or equivalent cost/MM for embeddings) without degrading answer quality beyond current baseline.
- Maintain p95 latency < 250ms for interactive flows.
- Pilot should produce concrete ops changes (batching + prefix caching + single-model quantized candidate) + a playbook for production rollout.

Redwood proposed pilot scope (high level):
- Week 0: baseline measurement (we’ll instrument a short token-cost and latency run against your dev traffic).
- Week 1–2: Batching + KV/prefix cache enablement for selected routes (chat and embeddings), run comparative economics.
- Week 3: Evaluate quantized model variant (we’ll propose 8-bit dynamic/LLM-int8 candidate) on a shadow workload; measure accuracy drift and cost.
- Readout: concrete delta in $/MM tokens, suggestions on autoscale/burst config and rollout playbook.

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Can you share a simple export of last 30 days of token counts by route (attachment preferred) — I’ve attached a MAP template to populate if useful.
2) Are you open to quantized model variants for the pilot (we can run accuracy regression and rollback quickly)?
3) Suggested tech contacts and times for a 30-min ops sync next week (Ben is on copy and will own the technical runbook).

Attachments: MAP_NovaPay_Sept7.xlsx (mutual action plan), redwood-pricing-grid-q3.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short calendar invite once you confirm windows.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

From: Elena Morales <elena@novapay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: James Liu <james.liu@novapay.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + pilot charter: NovaPay inference cost pressure & quantization openness

Hi Priya — this is great, thanks for the clear write-up. A few quick clarifications and answers: 

- I uploaded a lightweight export (last 30 days) as novapay-cost-export-aug.xlsx — it shows token counts by route and client. The big drivers are chat-assist and nightly embedding jobs for personalization.
- We are definitely interested in a 30–40% reduction; finance needs a clear before/after and not just model tuning.
- Quantization: engineering is open to trying 8-bit/4-bit variants as long as we have a rollback plan and can run automatic regression on our production prompts. We are sensitive to hallucination/regression risk on transaction-related answers.
- Constraints: compliance requires that production logs for the pilot remain retained within our GCP project; can Redwood support a private VPC option for the pilot telemetry?

Available for a 30-min ops sync: Wed 09/08 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 09/09 14:00–15:00 PT. James will join for the finance side if we have a pilot cost bucket estimate.

Attachment: novapay-cost-export-aug.xlsx

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Product — Personalization | NovaPay
elena@novapay.com | (212) 555-0198

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novapay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, James Liu <james.liu@novapay.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + pilot charter: NovaPay inference cost pressure & quantization openness

Elena — perfect, thanks for the export and for confirming quantization openness. Short next steps and commitments from our side so we can lock the pilot: 

1) Ops sync: Wed 09/08 10:00 PT (I’ll send the invite to the slot you confirmed). Ben will run through what we need for telemetry and the VPC telemetry option.
2) Pilot scope doc: I’ve attached pilot-scope-novapay.md and populated the baseline metrics we’ll collect (per-route $/MM tokens, p50/p95 latency, embeddings recall at k=10). Please scan and flag anything missing.
3) Compliance / VPC: Redwood supports private control plane and VPC connectors for telemetry. For the pilot we’ll set up an isolated telemetry sink to your GCP project and provide a short runbook for data retention. Ben will detail this on the call.
4) Quantization guardrails: we’ll run the quantized candidate against your provided prompt-set and production shadow traffic for two full days; if accuracy drops >2% on the regression suite we’ll pause and revert.

Deliverables and rough timeline: baseline run (48–72h) -> batching + cache enable (48h) -> quantization shadow (48h) -> readout. We estimate the technical pilot to be 2–3 weeks end-to-end.

Attachments: pilot-scope-novapay.md (pilot scope & metrics)
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234566/deal/4721

I’ll loop in our engineering lead for the pilot on the ops call. Thanks again — looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
